detail.longDescription: New post: "AI software factory" is this week's big term. It means the system around coding agents: specs, sandboxed runs, tests, review gates and deploys. I cover real examples, the difference between dark and release factories, and why I think the best tests beat the most agents. https:// blog.manig.dev/blog/ai-softwar e-factory # AIAgents # SoftwareEngineering
